notes: «- واللفظ للمسمعي وابن المثنى -» and «- وهو ابن هشام -» are editor glosses: left out
Ibn Umar speaks inside Sa'id's account of the encounter, so he is the last link (owner ruling 5); the first saying, Sa'id's own statement about Mus'ab, is in the same chain
Two sayings may be present (Mus'ab's and Ibn Umar's); no separate isnad is written for the second
